long_description:
Therapeutic Hot Yoga goes through the traditional 26 Hatha

yoga postures, beginning and ending with a breathing exercise. This

class is accessible for anyone regardless of age or ability level. It is an

ideal place to start your practice if you are new or a beginner. You will

feel the therapeutic benefits after just one session. The room is heated

from 90 degrees which helps your muscles warm up for deeper

stretching and promotes detoxification through sweat. There are no sun

salutations so it easy on the wrists and shoulders. The first portion of the

class is done standing where we focus on creating strength, stamina,

and balance. The second half is on the floor where the focus shifts

heavily to spinal mobility. You will be guided through every posture step

by step. Each instruction is given so that your body works optimally and

safely. Every class is the same but your experience, awareness and

perception changes each time you practice. Through consistency in a

structured program you will be able to deepen your internal experience

and track your progress. 26&2 classes are simple, consistent and

effective.

October 1st and 15th 6:30am-7:30am
